title: LiteSpeed Cache Setup
description: Configure LiteSpeed Cache for production — page cache, exclusions, optimization, and CDN.

steps.title: Confirm LiteSpeed / QUIC.cloud Compatibility
steps.instructions: Verify the host runs LiteSpeed or OpenLiteSpeed, or plan QUIC.cloud CDN if on Apache/Nginx. Avoid stacking another full-page cache plugin.

steps.title: Enable Page Cache
steps.instructions: Turn on cache for desktop and mobile. Set TTL appropriate for content change frequency and purge on publish.

steps.title: Exclude Dynamic & Logged-In URIs
steps.instructions: Exclude wp-admin, cart, checkout, my-account, and logged-in users. Add WooCommerce/EDD REST and AJAX endpoints as needed.

steps.title: Configure Object Cache (If Available)
steps.instructions: Enable Redis/Memcached object cache when the host provides it. Confirm admin and cron still behave correctly.

steps.title: Enable CSS/JS Optimization
steps.instructions: Enable minify and combine cautiously. Test checkout, forms, and sliders after optimization; exclude problematic scripts.

steps.title: Configure Image Optimization
steps.instructions: Enable WebP/AVIF generation and lazy load if appropriate. Verify hero images and logos still render crisply.

steps.title: Connect CDN or QUIC.cloud
steps.instructions: Link QUIC.cloud or custom CDN origin. Purge cache after deploy and confirm HTML and static assets serve correctly.
